fits.v: no — not as a head unit
fits.why: The ND has an integrated infotainment system (MZD Connect) on a screen that is part of the dash design, not a DIN slot. There is no 182 × 53 mm aperture to put this in, and the car's audio, reversing camera and vehicle settings live in the same unit.

aperture.v: none — integrated infotainment, no DIN slot
aperture.why: This is a design fact about the car, not a missing adapter.

depth_mm.why: There is no aperture to measure.

harness.v: not applicable as a head-unit replacement
harness.why: Removing MZD Connect takes vehicle settings and the reversing camera with it. That is a different and much larger project.

swc.why: The ND has steering-wheel controls, which is moot while the deck cannot be the head unit.

same_as_other_generations: Nothing. The ND is the break in the MX-5 line for this project: NA, NB and NC take a DIN head unit and the ND does not.
market_notes: The same everywhere — this is a limitation of the car, not of a market.

If you want the deck in an ND, the honest answer is that it becomes a second display fed over Bluetooth or aux, not a replacement head unit. That works and it is not what the rest of this repository describes.
gotchas: ⚠️ Do not buy parts for this on the assumption an adapter exists. It is not an adapter problem.
The deck still runs perfectly well on a desk, and the PC deck needs no car at all.
